title: Antigravity Workforce Orchestration Framework
summary: A framework for managing a team of AI agents as a 'Living Organism', now aligned with Google Antigravity standards (v2.2). It defines a standard directory tree anchored by a 'System Constitution' that governs Core Tenets, Native Operating Rules (with frontmatter), operating modes, and the mandatory 'Artifact Loop' (Plan-Execute-Verify). Implementation includes automated mirroring of laws and operational state.
